correctness.rationale: Correctness follows from uniqueness and dihedral-layer-swapping symmetry of extremal ellipsoids, which forces coaxial semiaxes and midheight center. All lateral facets are exactly the two edge-to-opposite-vertex orbits with centered support values R(A+B)/2 and slope R(B−A)/h. John containment reduces to b≤h/2 and a²+R²(B−A)²b²/h²≤R²(A+B)²/4. Because 1/2≤A≤B≤1, the volume objective is strictly increasing for b≤h/2; this yields a²=R²AB. The outer problem reduces to R²/a²+h²/(4b²)≤1, optimized at relative shares 2/3 and 1/3. Mixed polygonal area gives Vol(K) exactly; differentiating AB/(2A+B) proves strict ratio monotonicity and sharp endpoints. The actual package checker verifies 75 hull instances and facet containment/tangencies.
